chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Why McRae never joined Duke: pay compared with other bands
summary: He says Duke paid too little compared with white-band tenor men, and says Lionel Hampton later paid him top salary.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And I wanted more money for the musicians, because they had worked their hearts out, you know. On the road -- you know, you'd be working (inaudible) family a long time. It's worth something just to be out there all the time.
And they're making all that money, and they don't want to divide -- you know, "Look, give the guys a raise. This band should get more money."
The only reason why I never worked with
